author: Polhem contributors
name: Polhem App (Avalonia)
description: A Polhem application with Avalonia front ends: a JSON-RPC server that references the Polhem packages and one database driver, a desktop client built on the Polhem shell (optionally browser, iOS and Android clients too), a definition folder, and VS Code tasks that initialize the database and open DefineEditor.
symbols/database/description: The database engine the application uses.
symbols/company/description: The id of the first company, created when the database is initialized.
symbols/dbPassword/description: The database password written to Define/DatabaseSettings.xml. Leave it empty to enter it later in DefineEditor.
symbols/defaultLanguage/description: The default language of users who have none of their own.
symbols/browser/description: Add a browser (WebAssembly) client. Needs the wasm-tools workload.
symbols/ios/description: Add an iOS client. Needs the ios workload and Xcode.
symbols/android/description: Add an Android client. Needs the android workload and the Android SDK.
symbols/polhemVersion/description: The version of the Polhem packages and tools the application references.
symbols/skipRestore/description: Skip the automatic restore of the project on create.
postActions/restore/description: Restore NuGet packages required by this project.
